hero.headline: Everyone passes through. Give them a reason to *stay.*
hero.lead: Visit 29 Palms has made strengthening the brand and “improved visual storytelling on social media” its priorities, all aimed at more overnight stays in town. Hallpass can help turn that plan into stories people see, share, and book a room around.

plan.quote: Twentynine Palms is the vibrant heart of the Morongo Basin, where the spirit of *adventure, creativity, and timeless beauty* come together.
plan.quote_source: Visit 29 Palms TBID FY 2025–26 Tourism Marketing Plan & Budget, approved by the City Council Sept. 9, 2025, p. 7
plan.outside_help_heading: The plan already calls for storytellers.
plan.outside_help_quote: Page 11: “Partnerships with professional content creators and digital storytellers will highlight Twentynine Palms’ unique experiences through high-quality photography, video, and narrative features.” On Sept. 8, 2026, the City Council approved the 2026–27 plan and budget, and Breanne Dusastre told the council, “The story being told about Twentynine Palms continues to grow.”
